args.title: Tamarack Components: Retail Returns Logistics — Summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the Tamarack Components newsletter (Retail returns logistics), its linked article, and the companion piece:

- Apparel return rates have reached 24%.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling cost by a fifth.
- Resale within 10 days kept most of the margin.

Sources:
- Newsletter: Tamarack Components, "Retail returns logistics"
- Article: https://blog.tamarack.example/2026/returns
- Companion: https://insights.tamarack.example/returns/companion
